description: Lets SCREEN-001's linking path ask for the camera and then read a QR code with it. These are the only plugin commands the webview may call; everything else the UI does is an application command, which Tauri allows by default and which this file therefore must not enumerate. `allow-scan` alone is not enough: the plugin's `scan` checks the camera permission and throws rather than requesting it, so the two permission commands are part of the same single capability rather than a widening of it.
